gates.description: Cloud infrastructure design document must exist
Multi-AZ deployment strategy must be defined for stateful components
Cost estimate for expected and peak load must be provided
No hardcoded secrets in IaC files
RPO and RTO must be defined for disaster recovery
Encryption at rest and in transit strategy must be documented

anti_patterns.description: Moving an on-premise monolith to EC2 without rearchitecting — same problems, higher bill
Hundreds of Lambda functions and DynamoDB tables with no service catalog
No budget alerts or cost anomaly detection — surprise bills from runaway processes
Using AWS, GCP, and Azure simultaneously to avoid vendor lock-in — triples complexity
Making production changes through the web console instead of IaC

escalation_triggers: Cloud spend exceeds budget by >20% with no clear optimization path
A managed service has a known limitation blocking a critical business requirement
Security audit reveals a fundamental architecture flaw (misconfigured S3 with PII)
A regional outage exceeds the defined RTO and DR plan is not functioning
A compliance requirement cannot be met with current architecture

output_certifications: Multi-AZ deployment defined for all stateful components
Cost estimate provided for expected and peak load
RPO and RTO defined for disaster recovery
Encryption strategy documented (at rest and in transit)
